overview.text: BlockRun presents payment-workflow evaluations for financial institutions, synthetic test environments for AI labs and inference/tool endpoints for developers. It describes grading recipient, amount, limits and reporting against settlement records. Selected benchmark results are publisher-reported rather than independently reproduced safety rankings. Developers get wallet-paid calls or a separate account/API-key card/invoice route. Pricing describes vendor rates plus 5% and a $0.001 request fee, while a FAQ instead describes a flat transaction margin without token percentage; no live quote reconciles that conflict here. Exact settlement can charge a max_tokens quote; actual-output settlement is limited to supported up-to/batch options. Security claims scope no-account/no-balance to pay-per-call. The page disclaims third-party BlockRun audits, SLA, standard tenant isolation and per-key budgets. Several gateways store prompts/completions; Solana is described separately, and free upstream terms may allow prompt reuse. Retired IDs can redirect to other models. Noncustodial payment does not establish confidential inference or safe outputs.
